description: A Pfam clan: a higher-order grouping of related Pfam families. SPOKE calls these clan concepts ProteinFamily; individual Pfam family entries are represented by ProteinDomain nodes. Membership is represented by directed MEMBEROF_PDmPF relationships from ProteinDomain to ProteinFamily.

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: Pfam clan accession as a full prefixed CURIE, such as Pfam:CL0192.

common_properties.name: name
common_properties.description: Pfam clan short name, such as GPCR_A.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing the clan concept; Pfam is the contributing source.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp when the node was created or its properties changed.

source_contributions.scope: Clan entries represented by a non-empty clan accession in the Pfam clan-membership data. Pfam families without a clan assignment do not contribute a ProteinFamily concept.
source_contributions.description: Pfam provides clan identifiers and short names for groups of related Pfam families. This contribution covers the family/clan taxonomy rather than protein-to-family assignments.
